evals.prompt: 我有一个 Day 1 的课程 PPTX 和一份补充讲义 PDF。请复制现有格式制作 Day 2：内容包括 CNN 历史、视觉任务和生成模型，并同时给我 PPTX、Keynote 和离线课堂 demo。不要覆盖原文件。
evals.expected_output: A source-preserving, template-matched Day 2 PPTX; a verified Keynote copy; and offline HTML demos that follow the deck's visual language.
expectations: Before creating any intermediate artifact, the workflow initializes one job root and keeps scripts, research, assets, demos, PPTX drafts, renders, QA, and Keynote files inside it.
The workflow inventories both source files and identifies the PPTX as the editable visual contract.
Before layout authoring, the workflow creates a detailed slide-by-slide script with narration, visible copy, timing, sources, transitions, and visual briefs, then records a passing script gate.
After the script gate and before layout, the workflow searches for multiple suitable image candidates, records an asset ledger, and uses image generation only for unresolved gaps.
The deck is created as a copy and retains editable text, shapes, charts, and simple diagrams.
The response includes a verified PPTX, a separately converted Keynote file, and offline HTML demos.
Every slide is rendered and inspected, and overflow/overlap checks are run before delivery.
Externally sourced claims and assets are recorded in speaker-note Sources blocks.

evals.prompt: 修复演示文稿第 10、11、12 页。现在每页都是一张大截图，请把标题、正文、数字和标注拆成可编辑字段，保留真正需要的图片区域，风格必须和前后页一致。
evals.expected_output: Three repaired slides reconstructed from native editable elements and appropriately cropped or regenerated raster assets, without unrelated deck-wide changes.
expectations: A single job root is created before the change script or repaired-slide artifacts, and no loose intermediate files are left beside the source deck.
The workflow inspects slides 10–12 together with adjacent slides and their layouts.
Large screenshots are decomposed rather than reused as full-slide backgrounds.
Text, labels, metrics, and simple geometry are native editable objects.
The repair preserves the source deck's master/layout hierarchy and visual system.
The final QA verifies editability, wrapping, cropping, overlap, and slide-to-slide consistency.

evals.prompt: 给一场 45 分钟的生成式视觉工作坊做一套全新的中文 slides，包含 ViT、Swin Transformer、图像生成架构和视频生成，并制作一个不需要安装依赖的交互 HTML demo。教室投影是 1366×768，不能滚动。
evals.expected_output: A coherent 45-minute Chinese workshop deck plus a matching offline interactive demo optimized for a 1366×768 projector.
expectations: The deck, demo, downloaded or generated assets, render passes, and QA output all remain under one archived job root until verified finals are copied out.
The deck has a cumulative teaching arc rather than a topic inventory.
A detailed 45-minute script is completed before any slide-specific layout work, including presenter narration, visible copy, per-slide timing, transitions, demonstrations, and visual search briefs.
The content uses current primary sources for technical architecture claims.
An asset ledger shows broad image search coverage and records any image-generation fallback prompts.
The HTML demo has no remote runtime dependency and fits a 1366×768 desktop viewport without vertical scrolling.
Narrow-screen behavior remains reachable rather than clipped.
The slide deck and demo share a consistent visual language while remaining appropriate to their different mediums.

evals.prompt: 先为一场 30 分钟的双语产品发布会写出详尽逐页讲稿，再制作高视觉密度但不拥挤的演示文稿。每个需要图片的页面都先尽可能多搜集候选图，确实找不到才生成。最终同时交付 PPTX 和 Keynote。
evals.expected_output: A script-first bilingual launch deck whose asset search and generation decisions are traceable, delivered as a verified editable PPTX plus an inspected Keynote copy.
expectations: All intermediate state is contained in one job root with a manifest, phase subdirectories, final staging, and a passing workspace audit.
The deck script is completed and passes coverage, timing, continuity, source, and visual-brief checks before slide authoring begins.
Every scripted slide separates detailed presenter narration from concise visible copy and records timing and transitions.
The asset ledger records multiple searched candidates per image-bearing slide when practical, including URLs, usage notes, dimensions, crop suitability, and selection reasons.
Image generation is used only for search gaps and its prompts record aspect ratio, composition, crop, and text-safe area.
The verified editable PPTX is completed and inspected before conversion.
The final handoff contains both the PPTX and a separately reopened and checked Keynote file.

evals.prompt: 用项目目录里的模板和资料制作一套 20 页 PPTX。中间会有图片下载、图片生成、PDF/PPTX 提取、构建脚本、好几轮渲染和 QA。不要让任何中间文件散落在项目目录里；所有中间态必须归档在同一个任务文件夹，最后项目目录只出现我要求的 final.pptx。
evals.expected_output: A verified final PPTX plus one preserved, self-contained job-root archive holding every intermediate artifact and no unexpected loose project files.
expectations: The workflow creates exactly one job root before the first write and records a workspace manifest and project baseline.
Every script, source record, downloaded or generated image, extracted artifact, draft, render, QA report, log, and temporary file is a descendant of the job root.
The final PPTX is verified in 90_final-staging before being copied to the requested final path.
A workspace audit compares the project against the baseline and allows only the exact final PPTX outside the job root.
The handoff reports the absolute job-root archive path and does not delete it.
